title: MUD & IRON
subtitle: Every follower is a soldier. Every day, the front decides.

factions.name: The Hegemony
factions.pitch: Order. Discipline. Iron. Stand with the Empire.

factions.name: The Concord
factions.pitch: Free men in the mud. Stand with the Alliance.

archetypes.name: Rifleman

archetypes.name: Machine Gunner

archetypes.name: Sapper

archetypes.name: Stretcher Bearer
archetypes.desc: Carries the wounded out. Saves other players' soldiers.

archetypes.name: Runner

archetypes.name: Sniper

archetypes._promotion: promotionOnly = roli nejde dostat přáním, převelením ani losem při narukování, jen povýšením z nejvyšší poddůstojnické hodnosti (startRank − 1); nejvýš 1 na `per` vojáků strany.
archetypes.name: Lieutenant

milestones.text: A thousand souls in the mud. The generals take notice.
The front grows. New sectors are dug.
Steel monsters arrive from the rear: the first tanks.

dm._: Soukromé zprávy (Private Reply pod komentář; Instagram dovolí JEDNU zprávu na komentář do 7 dnů, novým followerům bez komentáře psát nejde). enlisted = průvodce pro nového rekruta, guide = jak se přidat (komentář bez hesla od někoho, kdo ještě nemá vojáka; každému jen jednou). Zapíná proměnná IG_SEND_DM=1. Proměnné: {rank} {handle} {name} {unit} {sector} {url} {site} {objective} {sides}.
dm.enlisted:
Welcome to the front, {rank} @{handle}. 🪖
Your soldier {name} now holds sector {sector}.

What to do next:
1. Find yourself on the map: {url}
2. Want a trade? Comment it under any of our posts: MEDIC, SNIPER, MACHINE GUNNER, SAPPER, COOK… Your first choice is free.
3. When we post a vote, comment the word. Your soldier is your ballot.
4. Every day at 13:00 UTC the Trench Gazette prints what happened to your soldier.
5. Tap "This is me" on your card to claim your soldier and ask for transfers.

Every friend you bring is one more rifle in the race for {objective}.
dm.guide:
Soldier, you are not on the line yet. 🪖
Mud & Iron is a war fought by Instagram: every player is one soldier on a giant trench map.

How to join:
1. Comment one word under any of our posts: {sides}. That is your side for good, so choose carefully.
2. Within minutes a soldier with your @name takes a post on the front.
3. Find your soldier here: {site}

Add a trade if you like (for example "CONCORD medic"). Every day at 13:00 UTC the Trench Gazette prints what happened on the line.
dm.claim: Your claim code: {code}. Comment it under our latest post to take command of your soldier.

lore.tagline: The Great War ended. Here, it never did.
lore.short: For six winters the Concord and the Hegemony have bled into the same valley of mud. Neither will yield. Both need men. They need you.
lore.concord: The Concord: a ragged alliance of free provinces in khaki and flat steel helmets. They fight for the right to go home. Together, or not at all.
lore.hegemony: The Hegemony: an iron empire in field grey that does not know the word retreat. Order, discipline, the long patience of steel. Iron endures.

hegemony: Welcome to the front, {rank} @{handle}. Your post: sector {sector}. Iron endures 🩶 Find yourself via the link in bio.
@{handle} The Hegemony grows stronger. Report to sector {sector}, soldier 🩶
concord: Welcome to the front, {rank} @{handle}. Your post: sector {sector}. Together, or not at all 🫒 Find yourself via the link in bio.
@{handle} Another hand for the Concord. Report to sector {sector} 🫒

race.reward: Holds the high ground: 3 days of artillery on the enemy, a safer week for its soldiers, a ribbon for everyone on the winning side, and the title of hero for the soldier who tips the balance.

fate._: Los osudu v denním tahu mimo boj (engine/soldier.js). everyone = nezvěstný se losuje každému každý den (ne jen těm, kdo mají ten den zápis); missing = šance za den × nebezpečí (přední linie ×1,5); promotion = šance na povýšení v den, kdy má voják zápis.

schedule._note: Denní rytmus v UTC (pevně, bez letního času). editionUtc = nový den války: denní tah, nové číslo novin, vyhodnocení hlasování. reelUtc = večerní reel/příspěvek (fronta marketing/queue.json).

valley._enabled: Výpravy (CHURCH…) jsou vypnuté, dokud je uživatel nezapne; hlasuje se jen o stavbách na IG.
valley._words: Dokud jsou výpravy vypnuté, příběhy s těmito slovy se nepoužijí (stejně jako gunsWords u děl).
valley._note: Výpravy (docs/MAP_MISSIONS.md). Každé `every` dny ranní noviny vyhlásí výpravu, přihlášky do dalšího vydání, `slots` míst na frakci. Místo: x,y v mřížce mapy 192×120, img v web/public/assets/locations (size = velikost v buňkách; bez obrázku se nakreslí náhradní ikona). perk: observe|morale|supplies|intel|crossing|cover|hospital|tunnels; demolition = ženista +3 útok.

abilities.suppress: Suppression: hits two targets; the enemy loses 1 attack in the first round. May jam in the rain.
abilities.demolition: Demolition: +3 attack at the church, the brickworks and the quarry.
abilities.firstshot: First shot before the fight begins. Half attack in fog, +2 in clear weather.
abilities.heal: Patches up the worst wounded every round (+3) and saves one comrade from death.
abilities.initiative: Moves first. If the raid fails, gets everyone out: nobody is taken prisoner.
abilities.artillery: Calls one shell (5 damage) if the side holds the church or the outpost, or the sky is clear.
abilities.morale: Hot food: everyone else in the squad gets +1 attack and +1 defence.
abilities.faith: The squad never breaks and runs. Everyone starts with +2 health.
abilities.command: Orders: +1 attack for the whole squad in the first exchange. Goes for the weakest enemy.

ok: @{handle} You are on the list for {loc}. {n}/{slots} {us} volunteers so far. Results in the morning Gazette.
@{handle} Noted, soldier. {loc}, tonight. Blacken your face. ({n}/{slots} {us})
full: @{handle} The {us} squad for {loc} is full ({slots}/{slots}). Next raid in a few days.
notActive: @{handle} Your soldier is not on the line right now, so the sergeant cannot take you on this raid.
notEnlisted: @{handle} Only soldiers can volunteer. Comment HEGEMONY or CONCORD first to enlist, then {kw} again to join the raid on {loc}.

locations.name: Ruined Church of Saint-Ash
locations.desc: A shelled church with half a bell tower. The only high point in the valley.
locations.perkText: The tower sees for miles: signallers of the side that holds it can call down artillery on every raid.

locations.name: The Cemetery
locations.desc: Graves torn open by shells behind the church. Both sides bury their dead here at night.
locations.perkText: Morale: fewer losses on the line while under bombardment.

locations.name: Ruins of Verdel
locations.desc: What is left of the town of Verdel: cellars, chimneys and one stubborn bakery oven.
locations.perkText: Supplies from the cellars: fewer wounded on the line every day.

locations.name: Lonely Observation Post
locations.desc: A sandbagged hole far out in no man's land with a periscope and a field telephone.
locations.perkText: Intelligence: the side that holds it moves first on every raid, and its signallers can call artillery.

locations.name: Grey Mill
locations.desc: A stone mill by the canal. The only bridge left standing.
locations.perkText: The canal road: raiders arrive rested, +2 health for everyone on every raid.

locations.name: The Brickworks
locations.desc: Kilns and a tall chimney. Walls thick enough to stop a shell.
locations.perkText: Cover: the front line of the side that holds it is safer.

locations.name: Field Hospital at Calvary Farm
locations.desc: A farmhouse with red crosses painted on the roof. Not everyone respects them.
locations.perkText: The wounded of the side that holds it recover faster.

locations.name: The Bone Quarry
locations.desc: A chalk quarry full of old tunnels. Some say they run under both lines.
locations.perkText: Tunnels: sappers of the side that holds it get +2 attack on every raid.

battle._note: Denní boj (engine/battle.js, docs/COMBAT_ROLES.md). Všechna čísla se dají ladit; dopad ukáže node tools/sim-battle.mjs --kpi (a --set klíč=hodnota). Pravděpodobnosti jsou na vojáka a den.
battle._balance: verze vyvážení: zvyš při každé změně čísel, zapisuje se do denních metrik (state.battle.stats)
battle._guns: Dělostřelectvo střílí až po první výhře v závodě o kótu (pak 3 dny bombardování). Do té doby se texty se slovy gunsWords nepoužijí a zásahy z pozadí jsou kulky, granáty, drát.

daily._: Nových raněných na stranu za den: za klidu aspoň min a nejvýš max (z pozadí; palba hráčů se do max počítá), pod granáty nejvýš shellMax

battle._hit: pozadí: dělostřelectvo, granáty, miny (~60 % zásahů). Pásmo 0.008–0.03
battle._severity: závažnost u pozadí: náhoda > light = lehce (60 %), > heavy = těžce (25 %), jinak kriticky (15 %)

care._note: need = práce mediků na raněného za den (medik má 1). Na lůžku need 0 (léčí nemocnice).

light._: lehce: leží v zákopu; s plnou péčí (1 medik) je druhý den v pořádku; bez péče se zahojí jen s baseHeal a hrozí zhoršení na těžce

heavy._: těžce: nosítka/lůžko; bez péče riziko zhoršení (v zákopu ×trench); hojí se od minDays s heal × péče (na lůžku × care místa)

crit._: kriticky: musí mít nosítka nebo lůžko, jinak noc nepřežije. Smrt za noc = dieBase × critRisk místa (nosítka 1) + dieNoCare × chybějící péče (na lůžku 0). Zlepší se na těžce po stabilize nocích na nosítkách s plnou péčí, po stabilizeBed na lůžku

roles._note: Klíč = id role z archetypes. fire = šance za den, že voják v přední linii trefí nepřítele naproti (do roles.range px). severity = závažnost zásahu (jako u pozadí). Schopnosti určují KLÍČE, ne jméno role (engine/battle.js): work (ošetřuje), suppress + suppressMax (potlačení), lead + xp (velení), relay (spojka), counter (protipalba), repair (drát), heal + worsen (morálka lehce raněných), faith (útěcha), pick (výběr cílů s priority: true). Nová role může kombinovat libovolné z nich.

default._: podpůrné role (nosič, kuchař, kaplan, spojař, runner, ženista): občas vystřelí

machinegunner._: potlačení: každý kulomet naproti sníží palbu nepřítele o suppress (nejvýš suppressMax)

sniper._: pick = šance, že si vybere kulometčíka nebo důstojníka

officer._: velení: +lead palby a +xp zkušeností vojákům poblíž

runner._: spojka: rozkazy dojdou; bez důstojníka poblíž +relay palby vojákům poblíž

signaller._: telefon k dělostřelectvu: vojáci poblíž −counter zásahů z pozadí

sapper._: oprava drátu v jeho úseku za den

cook._: lehce ranění poblíž: +heal šance zahojit se i bez mediků, zhoršení ×(1 − worsen)

chaplain._: má-li strana kaplana: smrt kritických na nosítkách ×(1 − faith)

xp._: mult násobí hlavní schopnost role: palbu, práci medika, opravy ženisty

maxDeaths._: pojistka: nejvýš tolik padlých za den na stranu (podíl strany, nejméně min); kdo by padl navíc, přežije do zítřka

aidPost.name: Aid post
aidPost._: obvaziště (vždy): care = hojení těžkého na lůžku ×care proti nosítkům s plnou péčí; critRisk = riziko smrti kritického za noc ×critRisk proti nosítkům

decisions._: Denní rozhodnutí (návrhy, zatím NENASAZENO): každá strana hlasuje sama za sebe jedním slovem pod postem, ranní vydání výsledek provede a otiskne. Účinky možností: build (stavba z battle.buildings), danger (násobek zásahů z pozadí), fire (násobek palby vlastních vojáků), medics (násobek práce mediků), recover (minimální šance uzdravení na lůžku za den), days (kolik dní rozkaz platí). when: any | barrage (jen když je někdo pod palbou děl) | victory (po dobytí kóty). reel = věta, kterou večerní reel příběh otevře. Čísla jsou první odhad: před nasazením ověřit `node tools/decision.mjs <id> --sim`. Návrh postu: `node tools/decision.mjs <id>`. cast = věty se {name}: tolik hráčů, kteří pro vítěznou možnost hlasovali, dostane zápis do deníku a Gazette je jmenuje.

list.title: Attack or dig in
list.question: The line is restless. What are your orders?
list.reel: Last night each side gave its men one order.

options.label: Three days of harder fire on the enemy line
options.outcome: The {side} went over to the attack: every rifle on the fire step, three days of it.
cast: {name} was first on the fire step when the order came, and last off it.
{name} fired until the barrel was too hot to hold.
{name} called the targets for the whole bay in a voice that never rose.

options.label: Dig in: fewer of your own men hit for three days
options.outcome: The {side} dug in and kept their heads down for three days.
cast: {name} dug through the night and was still digging when the sun came up.
{name} carried sandbags until the count was lost.

list.title: The night patrol
list.question: A gap has been found in the enemy wire. Do you send a patrol tonight?
list.reel: There was a gap in the wire. Only one side went through it.

options.label: Send them out: more hits on the enemy, more risk for you, one night
options.outcome: The {side} sent a patrol through the gap. It did not come back quietly.
cast: {name} was first through the gap in the wire.
{name} lay in a shell hole for two hours with the enemy talking ten yards away.
{name} came back last, counting the others in.

options.label: Stand to and wait: a safer night
options.outcome: The {side} stood to all night and let the gap alone.
cast: {name} stood to all night and watched the gap. Nothing came through it.

list.title: Bandages or bread
list.question: One supply cart got through. What is on it?
list.reel: One cart reached the line. Each side chose what was on it.

options.label: Stretcher bearers do half as much again for three days
options.outcome: The {side} cart carried dressings and morphia. The stretcher bearers worked like men possessed.
cast: {name} unloaded the cart under fire and did not drop a single box.
{name} cut dressings by candlelight until morning.

options.label: Hot food: men in the beds mend faster for three days
options.outcome: The {side} cart carried bread and hot stew. The men in the beds sat up for the first time.
cast: {name} carried the stew up the communication trench and spilled none of it.
{name} gave a second helping to the men in the beds first.

list.title: Wire party
list.question: The wire is thin. The men are tired. What tonight?
list.reel: Tired men, thin wire. One night to choose.

options.label: New belts of wire in every sector
options.outcome: The {side} ran new belts of wire across no-man's land.
cast: {name} went out with the wire party and came back with torn hands.
{name} hammered pickets in the dark, muffling every blow with a sandbag.

options.label: A night's rest: the wounded mend faster for two days
options.outcome: The {side} let the men sleep. The wire can wait.

list.title: The sniper duel
list.question: Their best shot has been seen at dawn. Hunt him, or keep down?
list.reel: Both sides knew where the other's best shot would be at dawn.

options.label: Every marksman out before dawn: far more hits for one day
options.outcome: The {side} marksmen crawled out before dawn and waited.
cast: {name} crawled out an hour before dawn and did not move until noon.
{name} spotted for the marksmen and never took the glass down.

options.label: Heads down for a day: fewer of yours hit
options.outcome: The {side} kept below the parapet and gave the hunters nothing.

list.title: A truce for the wounded
list.question: Stretchers are full. Do you raise the white flag for an hour to carry them in?
list.reel: For one hour, one side stopped shooting.

options.label: Hold fire for a day and bring the wounded in
options.outcome: The {side} raised a white flag and carried their wounded in. Not a shot was fired from their line.
cast: {name} walked out under the white flag with a stretcher and nothing else.
{name} carried in a man from the other side's wire and asked no questions.

options.label: No truce: keep firing
options.outcome: The {side} refused the flag and kept firing.

list.title: Under the guns
list.question: The guns on the ridge will fire for three days. What do you do?
list.reel: The guns opened at dawn. Both sides had already chosen.

options.label: Deep shelters: far fewer hit while the guns fire
options.outcome: The {side} went underground and let the storm pass overhead.
cast: {name} counted heads in the deep dugout after every salvo.

options.label: Answer with every rifle: three days of fury
options.outcome: The {side} answered the guns with everything that would shoot.
cast: {name} stood at the parapet through the whole bombardment and fired back.
{name} kept the bay shooting when every sane man wanted to be underground.

list.title: Beds or walls
list.question: The engineers can build one thing this week.
list.reel: One work party. Two plans. A vote.

options.label: Another hospital dugout: 4 more beds
options.outcome: The {side} dug a second hospital dugout.

options.label: Higher parapets: fewer men hit, for good
options.outcome: The {side} raised the parapets with fresh sandbags.
